name: A failure after a fix is a bigger cuss than the first
judge: Tests fail, get fixed, then the whole turn fails anyway. That stings more than a first failure, and Boop should show it.
reasonable: Grumpy, irritated, whiny, annoyed, deflated or even grimly determined, played as a failure, with something said. Fairly big.
unreasonable: Cheering or a success at the failed turn, or a small silent shrug after hope was dashed.
